We are always looking for passionate, motivated, and skilled individuals to join our team and contribute to our mission of excellence and sustainability.

## Certificates
[ ![1 management policy 1](https://rubin-glass.eu/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/1_management_policy-1.jpg) ](https://rubin-glass.eu/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Dekl_politika-v3.0-03092021-Eng-1.pdf)
Policy management – Manage policies related to the creation, managing and communication of all policies and procedures in the organization. Policy management is vital for the governance, risk, and compliances (CRG) strategy of the company and risk mitigation. Policy management also support senior management for implementing and directing company policies for the entire organization.
[ ![ISO9001 2015](https://rubin-glass.eu/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/ISO9001_2015.jpg) ](https://rubin-glass.eu/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/0114535_ENG_%D0%A0%D0%A3%D0%91%D0%98%D0%9D_%D0%A2%D0%A0%D0%95%D0%99%D0%94%D0%98%D0%9D%D0%93_%D0%95%D0%90%D0%94_Rubin_Trading_EAD_ISO9001.pdf)
ISO 9001:2015 Specifies requirement for a quality management system. It refers to providing products and services that meet customer and regulatory requirements, enhance customer satisfaction, including processes to improvement of the system.
[ ![ISO14001 2015](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20418%20418'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://rubin-glass.eu/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/0114536_ENG_%D0%A0%D0%A3%D0%91%D0%98%D0%9D_%D0%A2%D0%A0%D0%95%D0%99%D0%94%D0%98%D0%9D%D0%93_%D0%95%D0%90%D0%94_Rubin_Trading_EAD_ISO14001.pdf)
ISO 14001:2015 Specifies the requirements for an environmental management system that an organization can use to enhance its environmental performance. ISO 14001:2015 is intended for use by an organization seeking to manage its environmental responsibilities in a systematic manner that contributes to the environmental pillar of sustainability.
[ ![ISO22000 2018](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20418%20418'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://rubin-glass.eu/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/CT-ISO-22000_2018-UKAS-EN_%D0%A0%D0%A3%D0%91%D0%98%D0%9D-%D0%A2%D0%A0%D0%95%D0%99%D0%94%D0%98%D0%9D%D0%93-%D0%95%D0%90%D0%94_ISO22000.pdf)
ISO 22000:2018 Specifies the requirements for a food safety management system. It supports organizations to plan, implement, operate, and maintain products involved in food chain. Certification provides compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory of food safety requirements, evaluate customer safety requirements and effectively communicate food safety issues to interested parties in food chain.
[ ![ISO22301 2019](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20419%20419'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://rubin-glass.eu/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/0112471_ENG_%D0%A0%D0%A3%D0%91%D0%98%D0%9D_%D0%A2%D0%A0%D0%95%D0%99%D0%94%D0%98%D0%9D%D0%93_%D0%95%D0%90%D0%94__RUBIN_TRADING_EAD_ISO22301.pdf)
ISO 22301:2019 Specifies requirements to implement, maintain and improve a management system to protect against, reduce the likelihood of the occurrence of, prepare for, respond to, and recover from disruptions when they arise.
[ ![ISO45001 2018](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20418%20418'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://rubin-glass.eu/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/0102209_ENG_%D0%A0%D0%A3%D0%91%D0%98%D0%9D_%D0%A2%D0%A0%D0%95%D0%99%D0%94%D0%98%D0%9D%D0%93_%D0%95%D0%90%D0%94_Rubin_Trading_EAD_ISO45001.pdf)
ISO 45001:2018 Specifies requirements for an occupational health and safety (OH&S) management system. It provides guidance for its use, enabling organizations to provide safe and healthy workplaces by preventing work-related injury and ill health. It also focuses on proactively improving OH&S performance.
[ ![ISO5001 2018 1 1](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20418%20418'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://rubin-glass.eu/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/0180143_ENG_%D0%A0%D0%A3%D0%91%D0%98%D0%9D-%D0%A2%D0%A0%D0%95%D0%99%D0%94%D0%98%D0%9D%D0%93-%D0%95%D0%90%D0%94Rubin-Trading-EAD_ISO50001.pdf)
ISO 50001:2018 Energy management systems: The standard specifies the requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and improving an energy management system, whose purpose is to enable an organization to follow a systematic approach in achieving continual improvement of energy performance, including energy efficiency, energy security, energy use and consumption.
[ ![Screenshot 2024 07 24 155857](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20535%20411'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://rubin-glass.eu/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/FSSC-22000.pdf)
The FSSC 22000 (Food Safety System Certification) is a globally recognized certification for food safety management systems. It combines ISO 22000, sector-specific Pre-Requisite Programs (PRPs), and additional FSSC requirements, making it comprehensive and suitable for any organization in the food chain. It emphasizes continuous improvement, risk management, and consumer confidence, and is respected worldwide, facilitating international trade.

##  Rubin Design Glass Center 
##  Proven craftsmanship  and modern innovation for exceptional quality! 
At Rubin Design Glass Centre, we are committed to the seamless integration of exceptional design and innovative solutions. With decades of expertise in the field, we meticulously oversee every aspect of production to ensure the delivery of high-quality, reliable glass products. Our diverse portfolio spans various industries, including the production of bottles for spirits, beer, soft drinks, and olive oil, as well as jars for food.
We prioritize advanced technologies and cutting-edge equipment, enabling us to achieve both large-scale manufacturing and highly specialized, precision-driven designs. In addition to maintaining the highest standards of quality, sustainability is central to our operations. We employ energy-efficient processes and source raw materials thoughtfully to minimize our environmental footprint. Our mission is to provide products that not only meet practical and durability standards but also reflect our commitment to environmental stewardship.
